meta.title: Emilio Gappa
meta.description: Emilio Gappa builds AI systems and tests trading ideas against real data. Master in Management student in Lisbon, open to internships from January 2027.

hero.bio: I build AI systems and test ideas against real data, then report what actually holds up.

projects.name: Operations platform at Gonder
projects.what: An operations platform and a facility-management portal, built in-house at Gonder Group.
projects.result: Covers quoting, costing and fuel-card fraud checks for the fleet, plus a portal with AI contract extraction and 591 passing tests.
projects.note: Employer work, private code. Walkthrough on request.

projects.name: ImmoApp
projects.what: Property-management software for German private landlords, built together with Jan.
projects.figureCaption: in production · iOS beta on TestFlight
projects.result: Covers tax forms, utility-cost statements, rent indexation and bank reconciliation.

projects.name: Co-Driver
projects.what: A private AI assistant and personal CRM that triages messages, briefs before meetings and drafts replies.
projects.result: It acts only after each action is approved and signed on the phone.

projects.name: Apto
projects.what: A START Unicorn Lisbon hackathon app where students solve proctored company work samples and companies rank them.
projects.result: Built almost all of the app at the hackathon; the teammates led the pitch.

projects.name: alpha-graveyard
projects.what: Automated trading-strategy search, then a test of how many discoveries survive held-out data.
projects.result: The best in-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.65 fell to -0.12 on held-out data, and no candidate passed the Deflated Sharpe test.

projects.name: footnote
projects.what: Cited question answering over SEC 10-K filings, with a harness that measures how often it is right.
projects.figureCaption: answer accuracy: retrieved vs given passages
projects.result: Accuracy is 56% on retrieved passages and 92% when the right passages are given, so retrieval, not the model, is the bottleneck.

projects.name: blind-committee
projects.what: LLM analyst agents, a portfolio manager and a code-based risk manager acting on anonymised evidence.
projects.result: Agents returned +41.3% against +76.3% for equal weight, with a smaller drawdown (-9.2% vs -17.7%) and a Sharpe ratio not clearly different (1.54 vs 1.61).

projects.name: honest-odds
projects.what: A calibration study of 2,946 resolved Polymarket markets, with a strict out-of-sample check.
projects.figureCaption: calibration slope at 30 days (1.0 is calibrated)
projects.result: Prices are close to calibrated. A recalibration strategy had a positive point estimate, but every confidence interval after costs includes zero.

work.role: Working Student, CEO Office, AI & Process Automation

Built Salesforce and Excel dashboards for pipeline efficiency and client segmentation in an international B2B setting.

Exchange semester during the TUM degree.
